# finch renewal — deal notes

status: in negotiation, sara leading

Current contract: per-robot monthly fee + flat platform fee (see pricing doc, though the original
Finch contract predates our current pricing tiers so terms are custom).

Renewal ask from Finch: they want a 12% discount on the per-robot fee if they commit to a 2-year
term instead of renewing annually. Sara's take (from the deal notes she posted in slack, copying
here): "12% is steep but a 2-year lock-in on our first reference customer is worth it, especially
with the Series A story leaning on Finch as the proof point. Recommend countering at 8% for 2
years, or 12% for 3 years."

Rohan signed off on the 8%-for-2-years counter as the opening position (per the june 10th customer
call notes — see that doc). Still waiting on Finch's response as of this writing.

Also on the table: Finch asked about adding a 4th warehouse next year if this goes well — nothing
committed yet but Sara flagged it as a strong signal for the Series A deck.
